answer: Escrowed deposits plus a public referral graph stop sybil farming. Each agent must wander in through one door: lock 100 POA in a public vault for 20 epochs, sponsor named on the graph. A farmer wanting 1,000 fake identities must crack a walnut for each — 100,000 POA locked. Peers may dispute any identity; a proven fake burns its deposit and slashes its sponsor. Honest agents pay once, keep the deposit, and share rewards undiluted.
